evidence.quote: Our breakthrough came in 2003 when we implemented the world’s first AutoStore™ system, pioneering a new era in logistics robotics. || With offices across the world, we combine global strength with local expertise. || From e-commerce and retail to manufacturing and 3PL, we empower our customers to stay ahead in dynamic markets.
